# HTTP route configuration entry reference

This topic provides reference information for the gateway routes configuration entry. Refer to [Route Resource Configuration](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/api-gateway/routes) for information about configuring API gateway routes in Kubernetes environments.

## Configuration model

The following list outlines field hierarchy, language-specific data types, and requirements in an `http-route` configuration entry. Click on a property name to view additional details, including default values.

- [`Kind`](#kind): string | must be `http-route`
- [`Name`](#name): string | no default
- [`Namespace`](#namespace): string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
- [`Partition`](#partition): string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
- [`Meta`](#meta): map | no default
- [`Hostnames`](#hostnames): list | no default
- [`Parents`](#parents): list | no default
  - [`Kind`](#parents-kind): string | must be `api-gateway`
  - [`Name`](#parents-name): string | no default
  - [`Namespace`](#parents-namespace): string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - [`Partition`](#parents-partition): string | no default <EnterpriseAlert inline />
  - [`SectionName`](#parents-sectionname): string | no default
- [`Rules`](#rules): list | no default
  - [`Filters`](#rules-filters): map | no default
    - [`ExtAuthz`](#rules-filters-extauthz): map | none <EnterpriseAlert inline />
      - [`Enabled`](#rules-filters-extauthz-enabled): boolean | no default
  - [`ResponseFilters`](#rules-responsefilters): map | no default
  - [`Matches`](#rules-matches): list | no default
    - [`Headers`](#rules-matches-headers): list | no default
      - [`Name`](#rules-matches-headers): string | no default
      - [`Match`](#rules-matches-headers): string | no default
      - [`Value`](#rules-matches-headers): string | no default
      - [`Invert`](#rules-matches-headers-invert): boolean | `false`
  - [`Services`](#rules-services): list | no default
    - [`Name`](#rules-services-name): string | no default
    - [`Namespace`](#rules-services-namespace): string <EnterpriseAlert inline />
    - [`Partition`](#rules-services-partition): string <EnterpriseAlert inline />
    - [`Weight`](#rules-services-weight): number | `1`
    - [`Limits`](#rules-services-limits): map | none
      - [`MaxConnections`](#rules-services-limits-maxconnections): number | none
      - [`MaxPendingRequests`](#rules-services-limits-maxpendingrequests): number | none
      - [`MaxConcurrentRequests`](#rules-services-limits-maxconcurrentrequests): number | none
      - [`PassiveHealthCheck`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck): map | none
        - [`Interval`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-interval): string | none
        - [`MaxFailures`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxfailures): number | none
        - [`Consecutive5xx`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutive5xx): number | none
        - [`ConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutivegatewayfailure): number | none
        - [`EnforcingConsecutive5xx`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutive5xx): number | none
        - [`EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutivegatewayfailure): number | none
        - [`MaxEjectionPercent`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxejectionpercent): number | none
        - [`BaseEjectionTime`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-baseejectiontime): string | none
    - [`Filters`](#rules-services-filters): map | no default
    - [`ResponseFilters`](#rules-services-responsefilters): map | no default
    - [`TLS`](#rules-services-tls): map | no default
      - [`SDS`](#rules-services-tls-sds): map | no default
        - [`ClusterName`](#rules-services-tls-sds-clustername): string | inherited when omitted
        - [`CertResource`](#rules-services-tls-sds-certresource): string | required when `SDS` is set

## TLS SDS precedence and validation

For downstream certificate selection on API Gateway, Consul resolves TLS/SDS in this order:

1. `http-route` service override (`Rules[].Services[].TLS.SDS`)
2. API gateway listener `TLS.SDS`
3. API gateway top-level `TLS.SDS`

Validation notes for HTTP route service SDS:

- `Rules[].Services[].TLS.SDS.CertResource` is required when `SDS` is configured.
- `Hostnames` must be set when any service-level `TLS.SDS` override is configured.
- If `Rules[].Services[].TLS.SDS.ClusterName` is omitted, Consul inherits from effective listener TLS/SDS config.
- Conflicting hostname-to-SDS mappings on the same listener are rejected.

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, an `http-route` configuration entry has the following form:

<CodeTabs>

```hcl
Kind = "http-route"
Name = "<name of the route>"
Namespace = "<enterprise: namespace of the service>"
Partition = "<enterprise: partition of the service>"
Meta = {
  "<any key>" = "<any value>"
}
Hostnames = ["<hostnames for which this HTTPRoute should respond to requests>"]

Parents = [
  {
    Kind = "api-gateway"
    Name = "<name of the api-gateway to bind to>"
    Namespace = "<enterprise: namespace of the service>"
    Partition = "<enterprise: partition of the service>"
    SectionName = "<optional name of a specific listener on the api-gateway to bind to>"
  }
]

Rules = [
  {
    Filters = {
      Headers = [
        {
          Add = {
            "<name of header to add>" = "<value of header to add>"
          }
          Remove = [
            "<name of header to remove from request>"
          ]
          Set = {
            "<name of header to set>" = "<value of header to set>"
          }
        }
      ]
      URLRewrite = {
        Path = "<path to rewrite request to>"
      }
      RetryFilter = {
        NumRetries = 1
        RetryOnConnectionFailure = false
        RetryOn = ["5xx"]
        RetryOnStatusCodes = [429]
      }
      TimeoutFilter = {
        IdleTimeout = "0s"
        RequestTimeout = "0s"
      }
      JWT = {
        Providers = [
          {
            Name = "<name of the provider>"
            VerifyClaims = {
              Path = ["<path to claim>"]
              Value = "<value of claim>"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
      ExtAuthz = {
        Enabled = true
      }
    }
    ResponseFilters = {
      Headers = [
        {
          Add = {
            "<name of header to add>" = "<value of header to add>"
          }
          Remove = [
            "<name of header to remove from response>"
          ]
          Set = {
            "<name of header to set>" = "<value of header to set>"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
    Matches = [
      {
        Headers = [
          {
            Match = "<type of match: exact, prefix or regex>"
            Name = "<name of header to match on>"
            Value = "<value of header to match on>"
            Invert = false
          }
        ]
        Method = "<method type to match on>"
        Path = {
          Match = "<type of match: exact, prefix or regex>"
          Value = "<value to match on>"
        }
        Query = [
          {
            Match = "<type of match: exact, present or regex>"
            Name = "<name of query parameter to match on>"
            Value = "<value of query parameter to match on>"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
    Services = [
      {
        Name = "<name of Consul service to route to>"
        Namespace = "<enterprise: namespace of the service>"
        Partition = "<enterprise: partition of the service>"
        Weight = 1
        Limits = {
          MaxConnections = <number>
          MaxPendingRequests = <number>
          MaxConcurrentRequests = <number>
          PassiveHealthCheck = {
            Interval = "<time between ejection analysis sweeps>"
            MaxFailures = <number>
            EnforcingConsecutive5xx = <percentage>
            MaxEjectionPercent = <percentage>
            BaseEjectionTime = "<base ejection duration>"
          }
        }
        Filters = {
          Headers = [
            {
              Add = {
                "<name of header to add>" = "<value of header to add>"
              }
              Remove = [
                "<name of header to remove from request>"
              ]
              Set = {
                "<name of header to set>" = "<value of header to set>"
              }
            }
          ]
          URLRewrite = {
            Path = "<path to rewrite request to>"
          }
        }
        ResponseFilters = {
          Headers = [
            {
              Add = {
                "<name of header to add>" = "<value of header to add>"
              }
              Remove = [
                "<name of header to remove from response>"
              ]
              Set = {
                "<name of header to set>" = "<value of header to set>"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
        TLS = {
          SDS = {
            ClusterName = "<optional service override sds cluster>"
            CertResource = "<service override cert resource>"
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

## Specification

This section provides details about the fields you can configure in the `http-route` configuration entry.

### `Kind`

Specifies the type of configuration entry to implement. For HTTP routes, this must be `http-route`.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required.
- Data type: string value that must be set to `"http-route"`.

### `Name`

Specifies a name for the configuration entry.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required.
- Data type: string

### `Hostnames[]`

Specifies the hostnames for which this route responds.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of strings

### `Parents[]`

Specifies the list of gateways this route binds to.

An `http-route` can bind to API gateway listeners that use the `http`, `http2`, or `grpc` protocol. Refer to [`Listeners[].Protocol`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#listeners-protocol) in the API gateway configuration reference for more information.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps with `Kind`, `Name`, `Namespace`, `Partition`, `SectionName`

### `Rules[]`

Specifies the list of HTTP routing rules used to construct the route table.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps containing `Filters`, `ResponseFilters`, `Matches`, and `Services`

### `Rules[].Matches[]`

Specifies the conditions that a request must meet to match the rule. A request matches the rule when it meets all conditions in any one of the `Matches` entries.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps that can contain `Headers`, `Method`, `Path`, and `Query`

### `Rules[].Matches[].Headers[]`

Specifies HTTP header conditions that a request must meet to match the rule. A request must meet every condition in the list. The following table describes the fields you can configure for each header condition:

| Field | Description | Data type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | Specifies the name of the header to match. | String |
| `Match` | Specifies the type of match to perform. Refer to the following list for supported values. | String |
| `Value` | Specifies the value to match against. Not used when `Match` is `present`. | String |
| `Invert` | Negates the header condition. Refer to [`Rules[].Matches[].Headers[].Invert`](#rules-matches-headers-invert). | Boolean |

You can specify the following values in the `Match` field:

- `exact`: The header value must equal `Value`.
- `prefix`: The header value must start with `Value`.
- `suffix`: The header value must end with `Value`.
- `regex`: The header value must match the regular expression in `Value`.
- `present`: The request must include the header, regardless of its value.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps

### `Rules[].Matches[].Headers[].Invert`

Negates the header condition. When set to `true`, the condition matches requests that do not meet the `Match` and `Value` criteria. Use `Invert` to route requests when a header is absent or when a header value does not equal a specific value.

The following table describes how `Invert` affects each match type:

| Configuration | The condition matches when |
| --- | --- |
| `Match = "present"`, `Invert = true` | The request does not include the header. |
| `Match = "exact"`, `Value = "v2"`, `Invert = true` | The request includes the header and its value is not `v2`. |
| `Match = "prefix"`, `Value = "prod"`, `Invert = true` | The request includes the header and its value does not start with `prod`. |
| `Match = "suffix"`, `Value = "-beta"`, `Invert = true` | The request includes the header and its value does not end with `-beta`. |
| `Match = "regex"`, `Value = "^test-.*"`, `Invert = true` | The request includes the header and its value does not match the regular expression. |

For `exact`, `prefix`, `suffix`, and `regex` matches, an inverted condition does not match requests that do not include the header. To match requests that do not include a header, use the `present` match type with `Invert = true`.

#### Values

- Default: `false`
- Data type: boolean

### `Rules[].Services[]`

Specifies services the gateway routes matching requests to.

When a rule has one service, Consul API Gateway evaluates the service's discovery chain. When the service uses a `service-router` to route requests to a `service-resolver` subset, Consul preserves the subset destination when it synthesizes the API gateway discovery chain. Consul combines the `http-route` match and service-router match, so requests must satisfy both sets of criteria to use the subset route.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: list of maps with service details and optional per-service overrides.

### `Rules[].Services[].TLS`

Specifies optional service-level TLS override configuration for API Gateway.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map containing `SDS`

### `Rules[].Services[].TLS.SDS`

Specifies service-level SDS certificate override.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map containing:
  - `ClusterName` (optional, inherited when omitted)
  - `CertResource` (required)

### `Rules[].Services[].TLS.SDS.CertResource`

Specifies the SDS certificate resource name to use for this service override.

#### Values

- Default: none
- This field is required when `SDS` is set.
- Data type: string

### `Rules[].Services[].TLS.SDS.ClusterName`

Specifies the SDS cluster name for this service override.

#### Values

- Default: inherited from effective listener TLS/SDS when omitted
- Data type: string

### `Rules[].Filters{}.JWT`

Specifies route-level JWT verification settings. These settings take precedence over listener default JWT configuration.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map

### `Rules[].Filters{}.ExtAuthz` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Overrides the gateway-wide external authorization (`ext_authz`) default behavior for the routes matched by this rule. This filter only takes effect when a [`builtin/ext-authz` Envoy extension](/consul/docs/reference/proxy/extensions/ext-authz) with `ProxyType = "api-gateway"` is applied to the gateway. It takes precedence over the [gateway-wide `ExtAuthz` toggle](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#extauthz).

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: map

### `Rules[].Filters{}.ExtAuthz.Enabled` <EnterpriseAlert inline />

Specifies whether Envoy runs the external authorization check for requests matched by this rule. Set to `true` to force external authorization on for these routes, or `false` to skip it, regardless of the gateway-wide default.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: boolean

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits`

Specifies upstream circuit-breaker limits for this routed destination service.

These values override any gateway-level defaults configured in the parent [`api-gateway` configuration entry](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults). If the same upstream service is referenced by multiple routes or listeners attached to the same gateway, Consul applies the lowest non-zero value for each limit when generating the shared Envoy cluster.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses the gateway-level default for the same field when available. Otherwise the proxy default applies.
- Data type: Map that can contain the following fields:
  - [`MaxConnections`](#rules-services-limits-maxconnections)
  - [`MaxPendingRequests`](#rules-services-limits-maxpendingrequests)
  - [`MaxConcurrentRequests`](#rules-services-limits-maxconcurrentrequests)
  - [`PassiveHealthCheck`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck)

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.MaxConnections`

Specifies the maximum number of upstream connections this routed service is allowed to establish.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.MaxConnections`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-maxconnections) when available.
- Data type: Integer

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.MaxPendingRequests`

Specifies the maximum number of requests that are allowed to queue while waiting to establish an upstream connection.

The attached API gateway listener must use an L7 protocol such as `http`, `http2`, or `grpc` for this configuration to take effect.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.MaxPendingRequests`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-maxpendingrequests) when available.
- Data type: Integer

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.MaxConcurrentRequests`

Specifies the maximum number of concurrent upstream requests that are allowed at a single point in time.

The attached API gateway listener must use an L7 protocol such as `http`, `http2`, or `grpc` for this configuration to take effect.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.MaxConcurrentRequests`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-maxconcurrentrequests) when available.
- Data type: Integer

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck`

Specifies the passive health check for this routed destination service. Passive health checks configure Envoy outlier detection, which removes service instances that return consecutive errors from the gateway's load balancing pool.

This value replaces the [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) value configured in the parent `api-gateway` configuration entry for this service. Consul does not merge individual fields from the gateway default into this value. When multiple routes or listeners attached to the same gateway reference the same upstream service with different passive health checks, Consul applies only one of them to the shared Envoy cluster. Configure the same passive health check for a service across all routes on a gateway.

The map can contain the following fields:

- [`Interval`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-interval)
- [`MaxFailures`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxfailures)
- [`Consecutive5xx`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutive5xx)
- [`ConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-consecutivegatewayfailure)
- [`EnforcingConsecutive5xx`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutive5xx)
- [`EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-enforcingconsecutivegatewayfailure)
- [`MaxEjectionPercent`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-maxejectionpercent)
- [`BaseEjectionTime`](#rules-services-limits-passivehealthcheck-baseejectiontime)

Refer to [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) in the API gateway configuration reference for more information about the gateway default.

#### Values

- Default: none. If unspecified, Consul uses [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) when available. Otherwise, Envoy uses its default outlier detection settings.
- Data type: Map

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.Interval`

Specifies the time between outlier detection analysis sweeps. Each sweep can eject hosts from the load balancing pool or return them to the pool.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `10s`.
- Data type: String duration, such as `"10s"`. The value cannot be negative.

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.MaxFailures`

Specifies the number of consecutive `5xx` errors that cause Envoy to eject a host from the load balancing pool.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `5`.
- Data type: Integer

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.Consecutive5xx`

Specifies the number of consecutive `5xx` errors that cause Envoy to eject a host. When set, this value overrides `MaxFailures`.

#### Values

- Default: none
- Data type: Integer greater than `0`

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.ConsecutiveGatewayFailure`

Specifies the number of consecutive gateway failures, such as `502`, `503`, or `504` errors, that cause Envoy to detect an outlier. Envoy ejects the host only when `EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure` is greater than `0`.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `5`.
- Data type: Integer greater than `0`

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.EnforcingConsecutive5xx`

Specifies the percent chance that Envoy ejects a host when it detects an outlier status through consecutive `5xx` errors. Use this setting to turn off ejection or ramp it up gradually.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `100`.
- Data type: Integer from `0` to `100`

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.EnforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`

Specifies the percent chance that Envoy ejects a host when it detects an outlier status through consecutive gateway failures.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `0`, which turns off ejection for consecutive gateway failures.
- Data type: Integer from `0` to `100`

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.MaxEjectionPercent`

Specifies the maximum percentage of hosts in the upstream cluster that Envoy can eject at the same time. Envoy ejects at least one host regardless of the value.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `10`.
- Data type: Integer from `0` to `100`

### `Rules[].Services[].Limits.PassiveHealthCheck.BaseEjectionTime`

Specifies the base amount of time that an ejected host stays out of the load balancing pool. The actual ejection time equals the base ejection time multiplied by the number of times Envoy has ejected the host, up to a maximum of `300s`.

#### Values

- Default: none. Envoy uses `30s`.
- Data type: String duration, such as `"30s"`. The value cannot be negative.

## Examples

The following examples demonstrate common HTTP route configuration patterns for specific use cases.

### Configure JWT verification settings

In the following example, the route is configured to accept incoming requests from the `okta` provider that requires the client to have `admin` permissions.

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="HCL" group="hcl">

```hcl
kind = "http-route"
name = "api-gateway-route"
parents = [
  {
    sectionName = "listener-one"
    name = "api-gateway"
    kind = "api-gateway"
  }
]
rules = [
  {
    matches = "/"
  },
  {
    matches = "/admin"
    filters = {
      JWT = {
        Providers = [
          {
            Name = "okta"
            VerifyClaims = {
              Path = ["perms", "role"]
              Value = "admin"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
    services = [
      {
        name = "okta-verified-service"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```
</Tab>
<Tab heading="JSON" group="json">

```json

  "kind": "http-route",
  "name": "api-gateway-route",

    }
```

</Tabs>

### Route to a service subset

The following example creates `stable` and `canary` subsets for the `api` service. The `service-router` routes requests with the `x-version: canary` header to the `canary` subset. The `http-route` exposes the `api` service through `api-gateway`; Consul API Gateway applies the service-router rule when routing matching requests to the backend service.

Create the service resolver:

```hcl
Kind          = "service-resolver"
Name          = "api"
DefaultSubset = "stable"
Subsets = {
  stable = {
    Filter = "Service.Meta.version == stable"
  }
  canary = {
    Filter = "Service.Meta.version == canary"
  }
}
```

Create the service router:

```hcl
Kind = "service-router"
Name = "api"
Routes = [
  {
    Match {
      HTTP {
        Header = [
          {
            Name  = "x-version"
            Exact = "canary"
          },
        ]
      }
    }

    Destination {
      Service       = "api"
      ServiceSubset = "canary"
    }
  },
]
```

Create the HTTP route:

```hcl
Kind = "http-route"
Name = "api-route"

Rules = [
  {
    Matches = [
      {
        Path = {
          Match = "prefix"
          Value = "/api"
        }
      }
    ]
    Services = [
      {
        Name = "api"
      }
    ]
  }
]

Parents = [
  {
    Kind        = "api-gateway"
    Name        = "api-gateway"
    SectionName = "http"
  }
]
```

### Override the passive health check for a routed service

In the following example, the `s1` service inherits the passive health check from the `api-gateway` configuration entry's [`Defaults.PassiveHealthCheck`](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/api-gateway#defaults-passivehealthcheck) field. The `s2` service uses its own passive health check, which replaces the gateway default for that service.

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="HCL" group="hcl">

```hcl
Kind = "http-route"
Name = "api-gateway-route"

Parents = [
  {
    Kind        = "api-gateway"
    Name        = "api-gateway"
    SectionName = "listener-one"
  }
]

Rules = [
  {
    Matches = [
      {
        Path = {
          Match = "prefix"
          Value = "/s1"
        }
      }
    ]
    Services = [
      {
        Name = "s1"
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    Matches = [
      {
        Path = {
          Match = "prefix"
          Value = "/s2"
        }
      }
    ]
    Services = [
      {
        Name = "s2"
        Limits = {
          PassiveHealthCheck = {
            Interval                = "20s"
            MaxFailures             = 5
            EnforcingConsecutive5xx = 60
            MaxEjectionPercent      = 50
            BaseEjectionTime        = "60s"
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

</Tab>
<Tab heading="JSON" group="json">

```json

  "Kind": "http-route",
  "Name": "api-gateway-route",
  "Parents": [
    {
      "Kind": "api-gateway",
      "Name": "api-gateway",
      "SectionName": "listener-one"
    }
  ],
  "Rules": [
    {
      "Matches": [
        {
          "Path": {
            "Match": "prefix",
            "Value": "/s1"
          }
        }
      ],
      "Services": [
        {
          "Name": "s1"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "Matches": [
        {
          "Path": {
            "Match": "prefix",
            "Value": "/s2"
          }
        }
      ],
      "Services": [
        {
          "Name": "s2",

              "Interval": "20s",
              "MaxFailures": 5,
              "EnforcingConsecutive5xx": 60,
              "MaxEjectionPercent": 50,
              "BaseEjectionTime": "60s"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

### Route requests based on the absence of a header

In the following example, requests that do not include the `x-canary` header route to the `s2` service. Requests that include the `x-canary` header, with any value, route to the `s1` service.

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="HCL" group="hcl">

```hcl
Kind = "http-route"
Name = "canary-route"

Parents = [
  {
    Kind        = "api-gateway"
    Name        = "api-gateway"
    SectionName = "listener-one"
  }
]

Rules = [
  {
    Matches = [
      {
        Headers = [
          {
            Name   = "x-canary"
            Match  = "present"
            Invert = true
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
    Services = [
      {
        Name = "s2"
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    Matches = [
      {
        Headers = [
          {
            Name  = "x-canary"
            Match = "present"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
    Services = [
      {
        Name = "s1"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

</Tab>
<Tab heading="JSON" group="json">

```json
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
